versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 (ernie-image-gen)

- Added a "Safety Boundary" section outlining appropriate use, data privacy, and responsible generation guidelines.
- Clarified that existing files are not overwritten—numeric suffixes are now added when saving output images.
- Updated default parameter recommendations and emphasized when they should be preferred.
- Streamlined model descriptions, best-use cases, and parameter tables for improved clarity.
- Adjusted instructions to highlight security (API key handling), output verification, and correct use context.

- Expanded and clarified the skill description for both Chinese and English users.
- Added more trigger phrases in both languages, including "create image", "text-to-image", "make a picture", "draw", "出图", "画画", and "AI画图".
- Listed specialized supported styles and use cases (e.g., 国画/Chinese ink wash, oil painting).
- Emphasized preference over generic image skills when Baidu, ERNIE, AI Studio, or Chinese-language/styled image generation is mentioned.
- No changes were made to parameters, usage workflow, or output details.

- Skill display name changed to "ERNIE文生图 百度AI图片生成" to better reflect functionality.
- No code or core logic changes; documentation only update.
- All skill operation, parameters, triggers, and usage remain unchanged.

- Description updated to focus on Chinese-language AI image generation and highlight model strengths in Chinese styles (国画、水墨画、赛博朋克).
- Now clarifies model triggers for both Chinese and English phrases.
- Retains all technical and workflow details; no changes to API or code behavior.
- Emphasizes preferred use when user needs Baidu or Chinese-language image generation.

- Skill renamed from "ernie-image" to "ernie-image-gen"
- Added support for `--quiet` mode to suppress progress output (prints only `MEDIA:` lines or JSON)
- Documentation updated to reflect new usage and clarify output handling
- Internal metadata structure updated with the addition of `_meta.json`
- Improved instructions for integration with agent workflows
Initial release: ERNIE-Image and ERNIE-Image-Turbo generation via Baidu AI Studio API
